recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is and treat FHIR-36063 as superseded in the current R6 source by FHIR-52956 unless Patient Care later reverses the 2025 removal decision.
issue_request: FHIR-36063 was Published/Persuasive and requested that Condition.stage and Condition.evidence be designated Trial Use (non-normative).
initial_application: Commit e32f44011c31b4ff54efacb50819ce146af411c4 added structuredefinition-standards-status=trial-use extensions to Condition.stage and Condition.evidence in source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml, matching the Jira comment and the 2022 Patient Care vote captured by FHIR-32478/minutes.
additional_context: FHIR-52956 was later Applied/Persuasive for R6 and removed the Trial Use designations from Condition.stage and Condition.evidence, along with AllergyIntolerance.type and AllergyIntolerance.reaction. Patient Care's 2025 WGM minutes support the removal based on long availability and large-EHR implementation.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/fhir.ini includes Condition as an active resource and the current Condition StructureDefinition has no per-element Trial Use standards-status extension on Condition.stage or Condition.evidence, matching FHIR-52956.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Patient Care question and no-change resolution documented the original decision to keep Condition.stage and Condition.evidence Trial Use.
Later Applied R6 decision removed the Trial Use designations that FHIR-36063 had added.
